snippet.title: Touhou: BlackEight - First Person Anomaly Puzzle - Gameplay (PC)
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5008530/Touhou_BlackEight/
If there is an anomaly, do not put the lights out. Survive eight nights at Eientei in this first person Touhou Project horror fan game. 99 ruinous anomalies warp the sleeping girls in the dark, and the distance between Reimu, Marisa, Kaguya and Mokou shifts night by night. Exit 8 like, yuri horror.
